markup.message: <lt-tabs> has a tab list without a name. Write aria-label on .lt-tabs__list, like aria-label="Case sections", or aria-labelledby pointing at a heading. Without a name the screen reader only says "tab list".

fix.title: Give the tab list a name with aria-label
